_comment: Ratchet: each number is the worst median the nightly run may report before failing. Set 2026-09-24 from production medians after the load-path work (mobile-fresh lcp 996, cls 0.000; desktop lcp 568; returning cls 0.055) with headroom for a shared CI runner. Tighten after a verified improvement; never loosen without a reason in the commit message. mobile-returning.cls is 0.13 because opted-in tiles (depth strips, portfolio) mount after settings hydrate; measured 0.055–0.116 across runs on 2026-09-24. tabFullLoads is the number of document loads a tap on the STATS tab causes; it must stay 0 (a client-side navigation), because on 2026-09-24 OpenNext cache interception made Next fall back to a full page load on every tab tap.
